notes: Transcribed from sue604-evaluation.md §3.1 (unseen-topic holdout, no BEFORE baseline exists). One finding against this draft, recorded but not a FAIL per the source table: two attributions have no attributable source ("...지적이 나온다", "...시각도 있다") -- the draft's own analysis handed to an unnamed third party. This is F3 in the evaluation (routes to 'register': reg-news-attribution-placement needs a scope condition distinguishing a person who spoke, a document that states, and no attributable source, and should forbid the third). Comparative dimensions abstain: not assessed by the source evaluation. comparison.mode is "abstain" and outcome is ABSTAIN where no language dimension failed: the evaluation this record transcribes assessed only the seven absolute language_quality dimensions and made no comparative judgement against a reference on any of the five comparative axes. Recording mode "pairwise" would assert a comparison that never happened, and a comparative PASS would claim the draft was measured against the reference and held up. The references are still named because they were the genre-matched pool available and a later comparative pass should use them.
